question: ‘Prayag Prashasti’ was composed in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanskrit.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​**Prayag **is an ancient name of Allahabad as it is the meeting place or **‘Sangam’ of rivers Ganga, Yamuna, and Sarasvati.**
 
• **Prashasti **means “in praise of someone”. 
 
• **Prayag Prashasti** is the name given to the **Allahabad Pillar.**
 
• It is an** Ashokan Stambh** and has 4 different inscriptions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Harisena, also Harishena or Hirisena, was a 4th-century Sanskrit poet, panegyrist, and government minister.
 
• He was an important figure in the court of the Gupta emperor, Samudragupta.
 
• His most famous poem, written c. 345 CE, describes the bravery of Samudragupta and is inscribed on the Prayag-Prasasti inscription (Allahabad Pillar Inscription).
 
• ​Thus, we can say that Harisena wrote Prayag Prashasti.
